launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

* Most AI healthcare companies have been focusing on administrative tasks (authorizations/ scribing). We’re focusing on the main bottleneck in healthcare - clinical expertise. Our AI thinks like a doctor.
* It conducts comprehensive medical histories via voice interface, performs medical reasoning, and suggests evidence-based treatments / next steps (99% of the healthcare journey).
* Doctors can efficiently review text-based summaries on a back-end dashboard in under a minute, and maintain final medical decision-making control (the high value 1%).

<https://youtu.be/cUoLpodvLwE?si=fUzpo4LD3y3rzqtT>

---

### **The Problem**

1. **Traditional healthcare delivery is broken, with a fundamental supply/demand mismatch between the need for healthcare, and the number of doctors available to provide it.**
2. **The US healthcare system is facing a physician crisis**
   * Projected shortage of 86,000 physicians by 2036
   * 30% of physicians are leaving the field or moving part-time in the next 5 years due to the lack flexibility or burnout.
   * Patient volumes per physician are exploding, overwhelming doctors' capacity to deliver quality care
3. **Existing attempts to solve these problems have been step changes, and fail to lessen the burden of care on doctors:**
   * Traditional Telehealth simply moved the same broken workflows online, amounting to the same workload, if not more (”I think you’re on mute, Mrs. Jones…”)
   * Asynchronous messaging currently requires a lot of back and forth and hasn’t achieved adoption
   * Administrative streamlining AI services are great, but don’t tackle the fundamental bottleneck in healthcare which is clinical expertise.

### **The Solution**

FutureClinic is an EHR platform that powers digital medical clinics with sophisticated AI that handles 99% of the work, letting doctors focus purely on medical decision-making.

Our platform:

* Takes comprehensive medical histories through an empathetic voice interface
* Uses advanced medical reasoning to narrow down diagnoses
* Provides evidence-based treatment suggestions
* Presents doctors with concise text-based summaries, with all key findings cited
* Enables asynchronous care delivery without video/phone calls
* Built-in safety protocols flag potential contraindications and risks.
* Closes care gaps for patients with language barriers

---

### **Our Vision**

* Our EHR starts by powering digital medical clinics, but we ultimately power healthcare delivery in brick and mortar clinics and hospitals too.

---

### **About Us**

* 3 out of 4 co-founders are medical doctors as well as software engineers from top institutions (UCL, Imperial College London, Mount Sinai)
* Combined experience of >10,000 real-world patient encounters, with a deep understanding of physician needs and pain points (and scar tissue to prove it!)
* In previous roles, we’ve directly helped open >40 real world medical clinics in New York in the last 3 years, and know what it takes to deliver end-to-end care in a legal, compliant, and safe manner.
* Our President has >300,000 followers on social media, largely doctors and medical students, giving us an unfair advantage for early distribution.

### **Reach out!**

_For Doctors_**:** If you're interested in starting your own digit clinic with complete flexibility and control, visit [**openclinic.com**](http://tryopenclinic.com) to sign up or email [**founders@openclinic.com**](mailto:founders@tryopenclinic.com)

_For Healthcare Organizations_**:** If you're looking to launch a digital clinic or use our system for patient intake, we'd love to discuss how OpenClinic can help. Email [**founders@openclinic.com**](mailto:riyan@tryopenclinic.com)

launches.tagline: We help doctors instantly find the right medical codes to bill.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Charlene](https://linkedin.com/in/hsinleiwang) and [Warren](https://linkedin.com/in/warrenweinwang/), co-founders of [Ember Copilot](https://www.embercopilot.ai/).

# **TL;DR**

Ember Copilot helps surgery centers automate medical scribing, coding, and billing. Our autonomous coding solution achieves **98% accuracy** and reduces **denials by 55%.**

<https://youtu.be/jRSdwId10No> 

# **Why does medical coding matter?**

Medical coding determines how much healthcare providers get paid for their services. Without accurate coding, claims are denied, delaying or preventing payments for the work providers do.

# ​​**Why are we building autonomous medical coding?**

Today, many doctors still handle coding themselves, often relying on Google searches to navigate complex rules they weren't trained for. For example, as one billing manager shared:

"_We've got doctors that like to unbundle stuff, and not understanding that it's bundled, then you can't bill them separately_." 

This challenge becomes even more significant in surgical procedures, where multiple codes, complex bundling rules, and specific documentation requirements create confusion.

Some practices outsource coding and billing, but this approach isn’t perfect either. Coders aren’t in the exam room and often lack the full context of the patient encounter. This leads to time-consuming back-and-forth clarifications with physicians, delaying claims and introducing inaccuracies.

# **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87221&key=user_uploads/198052/642df116-7838-4e4b-92c6-a61052dd417b)

To help providers get started, we've made [ICD10codes.ai](http://ICD10codes.ai) free for everyone to use. Simply insert a diagnosis or your full clinical note to get the most relevant ICD-10 code back. This works for both diagnoses and procedures.

Our complete system goes further: 

* Handles ICD-10, CPT, and DRG while integrating directly with EHRs like EPIC. 
* Flags bundling issues, suggests appropriate modifiers, and validates documentation against payer requirements in real time.

 

This is especially valuable for surgical coding where providers deal with complex bundling rules and specific documentation requirements from payers like UnitedHealthcare’s enhanced requirements.

By combining autonomous coding with our scribing product, Ember Copilot helps providers identify missing documentation and meet requirements while the patient is still in the room. It’s like having a coding expert present at all times—without any overhead or delays.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87221&key=user_uploads/198052/d7e175a7-d2fd-4c32-9021-4f14323a624a)

# **Ask**

Know a doctor who takes insurance? Connect us! We’re looking to help:

* Physician offices
* Ambulatory surgery centers
* Government agencies

We’d love for them to try Ember Copilot on past claims and see the results directly.

👉 Try it for free at [ICD10codes.ai](http://ICD10codes.ai) or email us at [**founders@embercopilot.ai**](mailto:founders@embercopilot.ai)

Thank you!

Charlene & Warren

Hospitals struggle to communicate with linguistically diverse patients. Current solutions like human interpreters, phone services, or ad hoc translation by family members are slow, expensive, and often unavailable when needed most. Miscommunication leads to worse outcomes, longer hospital stays, and nearly doubles the cost of care.

---

## Our Solution ✅

Vocality Health is an AI-powered interpretation platform for hospitals that provides real-time, accurate, and clinically safe translation for doctors and patients.

Unlike existing services:

* **🏥 Instant & Always On** – No need to wait for an interpreter.
* **🧑‍⚕️ Built for Hospitals** – Designed for clinical use, not general-purpose translation. Compliant and built to preserve patient privacy.
* **📲 Fully Integrated** – Works with existing systems and hospital workflows.

Hospitals using Vocality get faster patient care, lower costs, and better outcomes.

---

## The Team 🤝

Vivek and I met as undergrads on the Harvard Cricket Club and later built [Fulltrack AI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/fulltrack-ai), a viral cricket app that became the #1 sports app in India, outranking the Olympics app (during the Olympics).

We’re now teaming up again to solve a problem that is deeply personal to both of us. After being denied coverage in the U.S., I spent years navigating international healthcare, experiencing firsthand how language barriers impact care and outcomes. Vivek, a PhD in speech generative models, has spent years developing AI to improve real-time communication. This problem is at the intersection of our experiences and expertise, and we couldn’t be more excited to be tackling it.

launches.body:
Hi everyone, [Josh Sabol](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshsabol/) here with [**HealthKey**](https://gethealthkey.com/) 👋

### **TL;DR**

HealthKey helps doctors offices generate more revenue by identifying patients who are eligible for clinical trials, and matches at-risk patients with cutting-edge treatments. Big Pharma pays _a lot_ of money to clinics for each patient they enroll, but _finding_ patients who qualify is an entirely manual process today. We use AI to prescreen doctors’ existing patients against Clinical Trials’ eligibility criteria, making enrollment fast and easy.

Are you a **Clinical Operations Leader** or a **Principal Investigator**? Book a **15-min demo** here 👉 <https://cal.com/healthkey/30-min-yc-launch>

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bm764eA6dhw>

### **The Problem**

Pharma/Biotech/Medical Device companies (a.k.a. Sponsors) rely on doctors’ offices (a.k.a. Research Sites) to find patients for clinical trials. **Each enrolled patient can bring a site anywhere from $20,000 to $100,000**. The problem is finding qualified patients. **Doctors have to manually search through dense medical records** looking for extremely specific criteria, for [**example**](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05683691#participation-criteria): “Prostate cancer in T2c stage, 20-80 cc in size determined via MRI.” **Existing search tools rely on simple data fields**, so they can’t handle these nuanced requirements. As a result, doctors manually sift through lists of 1000 patients with Prostate cancer only to discover \~5 patients match all eligibility criteria. The result is **wasted time, missed revenue, and fewer patients** getting access to potentially life-changing trials.

### **The Solution**

Our solution works in two steps:

**1. AI-Driven Prescreening**

We connect with clinics’ EHR system\* directly to pull all medical records, including faxed PDFs. Then we use AI to compare each patient’s medical history against a trial’s specific eligibility criteria. For example: prostate cancer’s status, stage, size, and impression source. We repeat this for every criterion, across all trials, creating a carefully vetted list of potential candidates ranked by how likely they are to qualify.

**2. Doctor Review**

Doctors log in to our dashboard to view the prescreened patients. For each candidate, HealthKey highlights the key pieces of evidence—such as MRI details or encounter notes—so doctors can verify if a patient qualifies. This feedback loop improves our system, making it fast and easy to identify, qualify and enroll patients into clinical trials.

Doctors can onboard in under a week with our existing integrations\*, or we’ll integrate with any certified EHR for free. Clinics only pay when they successfully identify qualified patients!

\* Current Electronic Health Record (EHR) integrations include Athena, Veradigm Allscripts, Epic, NextGen, and MedConnect.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87758&key=user_uploads/105349/63655e71-0364-435d-a48a-5eba0690ed2a)

### **Case Study: $1.4M in Missed Revenue at Urology Clinic**

One of our current partners is a +10 location urology practice. They have 4 research coordinators who each spend 3 hours every morning searching for trial candidates manually in their EHR. This manual screening is the most time-consuming part of their day.

Last year, they actively recruited for 11 clinical trials. They missed their enrollment targets because they couldn't identify enough eligible patients, resulting in $1.4M in missed revenue.

HealthKey has freed up countless hours of staff time, and has already identified 100s of eligible patients. With HealthKey's AI-powered Patient Identification, they're now positioned to meet enrollment targets and capture their full revenue opportunity.

### **The Ask**

Are you a **Clinical Operations Leader** or a **Principal Investigator**? Book a **15-min demo** here 👉 <https://cal.com/healthkey/30-min-yc-launch>

Finding patients for clinical trials is an enormous pain. If you know decision-makers in any of these organizations, we’d be super grateful for an introduction! Email us at [founders@gethealthkey.com](mailto:founders@gethealthkey.com)

1. Healthcare orgs that do Research or run Clinical Trials (Hospitals, Clinics, etc.)
2. Research Sites / Site Networks
3. Pharma companies
4. Bio-tech companies

6. Durable medical goods providers

Veronica and Sophia here, we’re building Harbera. Harbera is AI software that helps healthcare organizations keep their providers - physicians, dentists, nurse practitioners - in-network with insurers and compliant.

<https://youtu.be/75SKmVEMBvs>

## Without credentials doctors can’t treat patients

Credentialing is the bureaucratic process of verifying a providers’ qualifications and contracting them with insurance plans. The 900+ insurance companies across the U.S. have different and ever-changing credentialing requirements, and providers need to be re-credentialed regularly. 

Keeping providers credentialed is critical. If a provider falls out-of-network, it can take months to get credentialed again. Health systems are often unaware that a provider has fallen out-of-network until claims start getting denied, leading to disrupted patient care and billions in lost revenue.

## Monitoring credentialing is hard and gets harder at scale

There’s a lot that administrators need to keep track of: updates to insurance plan requirements (often mailed), license and certification expirations, malpractice sanctions, re-credentialing timelines, and more. Today, many back-office teams at hospitals and clinic groups use spreadsheets, filing cabinets, or even repurpose tools like Salesforce to track credentialing.

Here’s why monitoring is challenging for organizations:

* A telehealth company that accepts 10 insurance plans and works with 100 therapists across 30 states needs to track up to 30,000 statuses.
* A dental group working with 200 dentists needs to track 8,000 statuses. (Dentists are enrolled in over 40 insurance plans on average.)

## What we’re doing

We are making credentialing easy. Our software integrates with a healthcare organization’s existing systems to continuously monitor and proactively re-credential providers across states and insurance plans. We keep administrators in the loop so providers never fall out-of-network. We make onboarding new providers seamless with real-time document validation. We analyze credentialing trends to identify revenue growth opportunities and optimize staffing.

## About us

We’re best friends from college. We studied and taught Computer Science together at Harvard. [Veronica](https://www.linkedin.com/in/veronicanutting/) was a software engineer at Stripe, and [Sophia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophia--clark/) was a software engineer at House Rx, a specialty pharmacy software startup serving clinics across the country.

## Ask

Do you know health leaders that work in multi-state or multi-practice healthcare organizations, like dental support organizations (DSOs), telehealth companies, hospitals, or clinic groups? We’d love to meet them!

Email [founders@harbera.com](mailto:founders@harbera.com) to get in touch 🦡🧡

Patients wait months for an appointment, often with no guidance or symptom tracking in the meantime. When they finally see a doctor, the first 5-10 minutes of the visit are wasted gathering history instead of diagnosing and treating.

**Right now, there are only two ways to handle patient intake:**

* **Static intake forms** – Miss key details, forcing doctors to play catch-up.
* **Triage nurses** – Costly, difficult to scale, and still prone to oversight.

Paratus changes this. Our AI-powered intake assistant gathers symptoms, flags concerns, and delivers a structured clinical summary before the visit even starts—so doctors walk in fully informed.

Watch our demo [here](https://youtu.be/KHh7fp5svY8).

### **It’s Time for a New Wave of AI-Powered Intake**

✅ **Conversational AI engages patients before their visit,** collecting deeper insights than any form ever could.\
✅ **Doctor-approved triage** – Uses **500+ Schmitt-Thompson protocols** and cross-checks medical literature.\
✅ **Instant structured reports** – Doctors walk in fully prepared with:

* Symptom history & differential considerations
* Next steps & testing recommendations
* A pre-visit SOAP note for the EHR
* A full conversation transcript for review

**Think of it as a triage nurse who never misses a detail—at a fraction of the cost.**

### **How It Works**

1. **Instant Patient Connection** – The patient clicks an SMS link and connects with our AI assistant.
2. **Conversational AI Consultation** – Our AI dynamically adapts to responses, uncovering key details just like a triage nurse.
3. **Automated Pre-Visit Reports** – We run the full transcript through our fine-tuned LLM, extracting structured insights for the doctor.

### **The Problem: Long Waits & Inefficient Intake**

* **Months-long wait times** leave patients in limbo with no support.
* **Doctors start visits blind**, leading to rushed decisions and missed symptoms.
* **Triage nurses are expensive and inefficient**, yet essential for collecting high-quality data.

Paratus solves these problems, ensuring patients feel heard before their visit and doctors can focus on diagnosis, not data collection.

### **What Patients Are Saying**

_"I called as a mother for my son’s ear pain. I was impressed by the AI’s clarity, empathy, and ability to ask the right questions. Honestly, it was better to talk to than a real nurse!"_

### **Why Us?**

Best friends Tannen Hall and Pablo Bermudez-Canete, both AI students from Stanford, founded Paratus Health to fix a problem they experienced firsthand—the broken patient intake process.

For 11 years, Tannen watched his family members - and himself - grow sicker without a diagnosis for a rare disease. They endured months-long waits for every appointment, only to leave with more questions than answers. Each new doctor started from scratch, missing critical details that could have led to the right diagnosis sooner. By the time they finally got answers, it was too late to undo the damage.

That experience left Tannen frustrated with a system that forces patients to wait in limbo while their health deteriorates. He wrote about this problem in his Stanford application, and today, there is no one more determined to fix it.

Now, he and Pablo are building Paratus, an AI-powered intake platform that ensures no patient is left waiting without support and no doctor walks in unprepared.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87836&key=user_uploads/1786718/3a9b560c-8f62-4376-9297-67a19ff14f04)

### **Our Vision**

A world where doctors walk in ready to diagnose, not gather symptoms- because every patient’s full story is already in their hands.

### **Our Ask**

We’re currently running pilots and looking to connect with:

* Hospitals
* Physician offices
* Outpatient facilities
* Private clinics

Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/pablo-paratushealth/30min?month=2025-02)!

If you know someone who should see this, we’d love an introduction! Reach us at [pablo@paratushealth.com](https://mailto:pablo@paratushealth.com) or on [linkedin!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/paratushealth/)

**Let’s fix patient intake - so doctors can focus on care.**

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiltiwari-iitb/) & [Shivesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivesh-gupta-iitb/), co-founders of Frekil!  👋

## TL;DR

Frekil is an end-to-end platform to procure and annotate medical imaging datasets like Xrays, CTs, MRIs, etc 10x faster with AI assistance. We’ve partnered with radiology chains for large-scale imaging data, and have a global marketplace of radiologists for rapid, high-quality annotations.

https://youtu.be/2MYjUFp3r0Q?feature=shared

## ❗The Problem

AI is transforming healthcare, but the biggest bottleneck is still **access to medical images from hospitals and annotations by expert doctors**.

Healthcare AI and life sciences companies spend millions collecting medical images and hiring expert radiologists. But annotations? They're still:

📝 Manual\
🐢 Slow\
🔍 Hard to QA

Finding expert annotators with deep domain knowledge is tough, which means R&D teams waste months and large budgets on a process that should be seamless.

Medical annotation itself is uniquely challenging because it involves:

📦 Gigabyte-scale files\
🧠 Complex, multi-dimensional data that’s sensitive to loss\
🎯 Accuracy that’s absolutely critical

Yet most teams still use open-source desktop tools like 3D Slicer, built decades ago for solo researchers. These tools:

🚫 Require local machines\
📉 Offer no real-time collaboration\
📊 Force spreadsheet-based coordination\
🔐 Risk compliance and data security

And the result?\
Highly trained radiologists are stuck doing repetitive tasks manually wasting time, slowing innovation, and compromising data quality.

## 🧠 Our Solution

We transform the way healthcare AI teams prepare data by **accelerating and streamlining the entire annotation pipeline** — cutting timelines from months down to days.

Here’s how:

✅ Deliver fully annotated **medical datasets** tailored for AI research needs

✅ Provide certified and benchmarked **radiologists** for annotation and quality assurance

✅ Offer advanced, browser-based annotation tools for all kinds of medical images—radiology, pathology, histopathology, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, etc

✅ Use **AI assistance** to make annotators **10x faster**

✅ Enable customizable clinical workflows with multi-stage reviews & annotations

✅ Ensure **FDA-Ready** annotation versioning, consensus checks, and full audit trails

✅ Track annotator performance in cost, time, and **accuracy** - all built in

For 4+ years now, I’ve struggled to navigate several chronic low back conditions. I often waited weeks for responses from my care team, received little guidance about new diagnoses, and felt overwhelmed trying to manage overlapping conditions and medications.

Increasingly, **patients are trusting LLMs with their health questions**, but these tools weren’t built to understand a person’s full clinical history, wearable data, and evolving health context, so they fall short of delivering truly personalized insights.

Meet Galen AI — our AI-powered solution to make high-quality, personal medical support accessible to everyone. No more screenshotting your records and uploading them to ChatGPT. No more WebMD rabbit holes about your symptoms. No more waiting months for your next doctor’s appointment.

It also syncs with your **Apple Watch** to bring in daily fitness and activity data, with support for **20+ additional wearables** coming soon.

As you share new symptoms and health updates, Galen **keeps track** and **continuously learns** about your evolving needs, providing long-term support.

\
Many home health and home care agencies have to literally say no to patients who need care.

We want medical billing to be a **one-click** process. Billers should spend their time making the important decisions and triaging involved in the revenue cycle process.

Our initial product has been rolled out to early customers and has already

1. turned a 3 day a week billing process to a 2 hour process

launches.body:
Hey YC [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re [Max B](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maximeberthelot/), [Baptiste](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bdebever/), and [Max G](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxguerois/) - co-founders of [Lucis](https://www.lucis.life/).

### **TL;DR**

**Lucis turns regular blood tests into actionable health insights - so people can act before it’s too late.** In 4 months, we’ve helped 500 people in Paris get ahead of chronic diseases. Today, we’re expanding across Europe.

https://youtu.be/a5fX1K5hnvU

### **The Problem In Europe**

85% of deaths are caused by preventable chronic diseases. That’s more than 4 million lives lost every year just in Europe. Yet, the healthcare system remains reactive, and people receive care only after something goes wrong.

Those seeking comprehensive preventive care, including blood testing, analysis, and expert guidance, typically resort to private longevity clinics that charge over €50K per year. **Such premium healthcare remains inaccessible to the vast majority of people.**

### **Lucis: Health Insights in Your Pocket**

_“If you're tired of being in the dark about your health, not knowing where you stand or what to do next, Lucis is built for you.”_

Lucis goes beyond vague checkups and unreadable lab reports. It provides a clear health baseline, tracks progress over time, and translates complex biomarker data into personalized guidance people can actually implement in their daily lives. All at a fraction of the cost of a private clinic.

You’ll get answers to questions like:

_"Am I aging faster than I should?"_

_"Is my testosterone at a healthy level for my age?"_

_"How can I improve my next marathon performance?"_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90454&key=user_uploads/1454634/0a347d82-7c9b-4fef-8c72-bf70511ce761)

Here’s how it works:

* 2 full health check-ups per year
* See how your body’s doing with 15 health scores and your biological age - and track your progress over time.
* Personalized action plan across nutrition, sleep, and movement
* Access to longevity add-on tests, like microbiome, continuous glucose monitoring, and food sensitivity tests.

### **The Team**

We started Lucis because we’ve lived the problem ourselves.

Baptiste lost a close relative to a condition that could’ve been caught earlier. Max B has spent the last decade deep in biohacking, testing everything from supplements to wearables. Hey everyone 👋

We’re **Georges and Mathieu — co-founders of Novoflow**.

### **TL;DR**

Novoflow’s multilingual voice agent answers every inbound & outbound call, schedules directly inside any EHR (Epic, Athena, Medent—even 1990s HL7 feeds), and slashes no-shows. Clinics can reclaim **up to $50k/month** on average in missed revenue without hiring another receptionist.

https://youtu.be/LQA-QeiY_F4

### **❌ The Problem**

The old reception model is breaking. Outsourced call centers, dead-end IVRs, and half-integrated schedulers still miss 42% of patient calls. Each unbooked physician hour stacks into a $50,000 monthly loss in revenue per average independent clinic. Medical practices are stuck because decade-old and proprietary EHRs can’t accept real-time integrations from next-gen solutions.

### **🏥 Our Solution**

**Full-stack AI receptionist**

1. **24 / 7 voice AI** greets patients in 25+ languages, verifies insurance, and classifies intent in real-time.
2. **Universal EHR plumbing** writes, reschedules, or cancels appointments natively inside any system.
3. **One-hour go-live**: point our SIP trunk at the clinic’s number—no new phones, no code.
4. **Dashboard & KPIs**: abandonment, call-to-appointment conversion, provider utilization, no-show rate.

Early adopters project a **10% jump in provider utilization** and a **22% lift in call-to-appointment conversion**—with happier patients to match.

* Know an independent clinic, multi-specialty group, or surgery center bleeding revenue to missed calls?

We spent two years as French & Spanish medical interpreters. Receptionists called us after hours because patients couldn’t communicate, and clinics lost money while care was delayed. We realized **voice AI + universal EHR integration** could fix the bottleneck for the 100k+ clinics still trapped by legacy software.

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/), [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/), and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/) — co-founders of [Adentris](https://www.adentris.com/).

**TL;DR:**

Every year, **250 million insurance claims — worth billions of dollars — are denied due to documentation errors**. Many are never recovered. We connect directly to hospital EHRs, monitor clinical staff activity logs in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix compliance issues before they become risks. **Since the beginning of YC, we’ve reached $54k ARR** and have a growing number of commercial pilots with hospitals and clinics across the U.S. and PoCs with healthcare enterprises.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrcEY8WgmSk

**Problem:**

One small documentation mistake — like recording a medication time incorrectly — can destroy a family’s finances.

These errors are often made by exhausted clinicians after 12-hour shifts and are caught by automated insurance systems that instantly deny the claim.

**Hospitals don’t discover the problem until it's too late** — after the claim is denied, the audit triggered, or the reputation damaged.

Documentation errors are the invisible threat in modern healthcare. They’re not caused by negligence, but by broken systems: cluttered interfaces, overworked staff, and legacy EHRs that make it easy to click the wrong time, forget a discharge note, or miss a required signature.

**And it’s not just claims** — these small errors lead to failed audits, regulatory fines, delayed discharges, and increased burnout.

Hospitals end up with compliance teams that are reactive — chasing mistakes days or weeks after they happened, often without resolution. The cost isn’t just money. It’s morale, trust, and patient safety.

**Solution:**

Adentris is an AI compliance autopilot that prevents small documentation errors from becoming costly disasters in real time.

We integrate directly with hospital EHRs, monitor clinical activity in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix issues — like missed discharge notes or wrong medication times — before they trigger claim denials or audits.

When a problem is found, our AI opens a quick conversation with the responsible staff member to confirm and correct it immediately.

**We don’t just alert**. We resolve — and help hospitals run smoother, reduce pressure on teams, and recover revenue that would otherwise be lost.

**What Experts Are Saying:**

"Adentris’s proactive approach is a game‑changer in reducing preventable errors and enabling real‑time accountability in care delivery.”

— [Joel N.H. Stern, PhD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joel-n-h-stern-07a4342/)\
Professor of Neurology & Molecular Medicine, Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell

**Team:**

[Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/) (CEO) and [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/) (CPO) are second-time YC founders with a strong track record in building B2B enterprise products and go-to-market channels. Sergey comes from a full medical family and has deep personal ties to the problems we're solving in healthcare. [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/), (CTO), is a seasoned engineer who built apps used by 25M+ people worldwide and led the development of a full AI agent architecture at his previous multimillion-dollar startup.

**Asks:**

We're actively looking to connect with:

* **Hospital executives and clinic owners** who want to stop losing revenue to preventable compliance errors and team burnout 
* **Providers' CFOs and compliance leaders** who are tired of fighting with clinical staff over documentation and want a system that just works
* **Medical institution advisors and operators** who care about transforming broken workflows
* **Reporters and storytellers** covering the untold side of healthcare — the back office chaos that leads to financial disaster

If you're building, reporting on, or fighting to fix this problem — DM us, email us at [founders@wrkdn.com](mailto:founders@wrkdn.com), or grab 15 minutes with us here [Book a call](https://calendly.com/d/cnpv-x29-nzc/workdone-demo).

launches.tagline: AI agents that capture the risk, close the gaps, and make the calls, so small teams can keep whole populations healthy.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We’re Lalit and Catherine, co-founders of Pelica Health.

## **TL;DR**

Pelica is the AI operating system for value-based care. We pull claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and hospital feeds into **one canonical record**, then run AI copilots that read and write to it: risk adjustment, Stars and quality, pharmacy, provider network, and care management, plus an AI data analyst you can ask anything in plain English. The copilots **do the operational work themselves**: capturing HCCs in real time, closing gaps once across every payer, and making outreach calls in the member’s language. HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and RADV-defensible.

We’re live with a physician-led IPA in New York, one of the largest independent medical groups in the Northeast: **2,500+ hours saved** and higher CMS Star Ratings so far.

▶️ Watch their story: <https://youtu.be/2CGmyif9Yd4>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/e873acc4-f206-4eca-8617-9bf7f70f3b62)

_An AI agent works one gap end to end: provider office, pharmacy, the member in their language, the payer portal, then a live call. Closed in 3 minutes of staff time._

## **🚩 The problem**

Value-based care pays a medical group or health plan to keep a whole population healthy, and billions in CMS bonuses ride on it. The teams who own those contracts decide whether the org makes money, and they cannot operate:

• Their data lives in 8 to 15 systems. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.

• Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again, sometimes in a language the member doesn’t speak.

• The best predictive model is worthless if it never reaches the provider.

• The rules keep moving. Hybrid HEDIS is retiring into ECDS volumes many times higher per measure, and the V28 phase-in costs the average MA plan about 3% of RAF.

Every new gap gets a new point vendor, each with its own portal, data model, and login. These teams do not need another point tool. They need an operating system.

## **🛠️ What we built**

One canonical record, with an AI workforce next to every team. Six copilots:

• **Risk Adjustment:** real-time HCC capture with trumping logic and RADV-defensible chain of custody on every code.

• **Quality and Stars:** gap closure unified across every payer, with year-round forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.

• **Pharmacy and Part D:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures that move Stars the most.

• **Provider Network:** auto-built practice agendas that cut meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.

• **Care Management:** ADT-driven transitions-of-care worklists, with no duplicate calls across teams.

• **AI Data Analyst:** plain-English questions against the record, in place of the BI ticket queue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/13a2d9aa-5ac8-4ab4-bf2c-b61fe8bccb56)

_Risk Adjustment: the agent works the EHR and payer portals like a person and captures a defensible HCC._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/cfb57b8c-bf75-43d1-9dc3-d29da891d8e9)

_AI Data Analyst: ask your RAF in plain English, get an answer and a chart in seconds._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/4bbf9afb-abc0-4221-9e5b-bf4602654e32)

_Provider Network: reps walk in prepped, and the visit is captured into tasks automatically._

It runs on the systems VBC teams already use: Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, and labs, with SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena. A new source onboards in days, and the copilots start working the day after.

## **📈 Early proof**

That physician-led IPA went from three uncoordinated calls per member to one outreach, in the right language, that closed three gaps at once. No new headcount. One of their leaders put it simply: “You don’t just get software, you get partners.”

## **👫 Why us**

Catherine and I met at YouTube and have built large-scale systems together since. We saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations software that could not reason clinically.

• **Catherine** led AI work on Gemini and enterprise agents at Google, did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine, and saw front-line care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

• **Lalit** spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube, most recently as engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-person team on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA, ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

## **🙏 Our ask**

• Warm intros to VPs of Risk Adjustment, Stars, Quality, or Pharmacy at MA plans, IPAs, MSOs, or ACOs.

• Intros to ACO executive directors running MSSP or REACH.

• If you run risk-bearing contracts at a health plan, IPA, MSO, ACO, or medical group, email [lalit@pelica.com](mailto:lalit@pelica.com) or book a demo at cal.com/pelica/pelica.

Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7475922350316732416/) and [X](https://x.com/cthrnzh/status/2070159740295160294), and learn more at [pelica.com](http://pelica.com).

launches.body:
We’re [Krishang Todi](https://linkedin.com/in/krishang-todi-a6525b135), [Aarav Bajaj](https://linkedin.com/in/aarav-bajaj-408ab01b1) , and [Dhanya Shah](https://linkedin.com/in/dhanya-shah-97878835b) and we’re building [Aegis.](https://aegishealth.us)\
💥 **TL;DR:** \
Aegis **automates the insurance appeals** **process end-to-end**: from denial detection and compliant appeal generation to submission, tracking, and actionable analytics. We integrate with EHRs, clearinghouses, and payer portals, helping providers and medical billing firms **recover lost revenue and save significant staff time.**

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/6AYEhYpMjBQ)

\
**🩺 The Problem** \
US healthcare providers lose **$260B+** annually to denied claims, and spend **$20B+** fighting them. Yet **fewer than 15%** of denials are appealed - even though **over 50%** of appeals are successful. With AI-driven denials on the rise, the system is collapsing under its own weight.

The current process of fighting a denial is manual, time-consuming and riddled with inefficiencies. \
\
🧠 **The Solution** \
Aegis plugs into a provider’s existing data stack (EHR, PMS, clearinghouses) to:

* **Detect denials automatically:** Aegis continuously monitors claims data streams from your clearinghouse and instantly flags denied claims without requiring manual intervention. These denied claims are then arranged by priority based on deadline and claim value.
* **Pull patient records, EOBs, and payor docs:** Aegis integrates with the EHR to fetch supporting materials, such as patient records, Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), and payer correspondence.
* **Generate and submit appeal packages:** Using AI trained on successful appeal language and payer requirements, Aegis drafts customized appeal letters, compiles required documentation, and submits the appeal directly to the insurance provider via appropriate channels (fax, portal, or clearinghouse).
* **Track appeal progress and surface denial insights:** Aegis provides end-to-end tracking of every appeal, including submission confirmation, status updates, and final resolution. Over time, it also analyzes patterns in denials- by payer, procedure, provider, and code- to help providers take proactive steps to reduce future denial rates.

launches.tagline: Building foundation models to design better RNA therapeutics, starting with mRNA design.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Jonny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonathanhsuuw/), [Ian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ruian-shi-4b5215b9/), and [Phil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/philip-fradkin-330a417b/), co-founders of [Blank Bio](https://www.blank.bio/) 👋

We’ve spent decades applying machine learning to biology across academia (Ph.D.’s at the University of Toronto) and industry (Recursion, Deep Genomics, Amazon). 

https://youtu.be/7lULj-S-MgQ?feature=shared

**TLDR:** 

* mRNA enables programmable, personalized medicine, from gene therapies to cancer vaccines. But with more possible sequences than stars in the universe, brute-force design is impossible.
* We built a state-of-the-art RNA foundation [model](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.10.617658v3) to predict and design high-performing sequences, letting pharma **simulate costly experiments** and speed up timelines. 
* Our open-source models are used by Sanofi and GSK, and we’re working with the Arc Institute to power next-gen virtual cell models.
* mRNA design is just the beginning. We’re expanding to applications like target identification, biomarker discovery, patient stratification, and more

**Asks:** We’re looking to connect with pharma and biotech companies working on mRNA-based therapeutics (i.e. Moderna, BioNTech, Orbital etc.), CRISPR therapeutics (Scribe, Intellia, Editas, etc.), and biomarker discovery.

📤If you know anyone in those spaces, we’d love an intro: [jonathan@blank.bio](mailto:jonathan@blank.bio) 📤

**Who are we?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92787&key=user_uploads/1842799/964fb41d-c751-418d-aecb-5dbbd0fc7405)

* **Jonny**: One of the first employees at Valence Discovery, an AI for drug discovery company spun out of Mila. Acquired by Recursion (NASDAQ: RXRX). Biochemist by training (Waterloo) 
* **Ian**: 10 years of experience in comp bio. Prev. researcher at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Centre (now leading the charge on cancer vaccines) and engineer at Amazon. Has a PhD in computer science (University of Toronto)
* **Phil**: 12 years of experience in ML for bio. Spent 4 years at Deep Genomics, where he was one of the first employees. Has a PhD in computational biology (University of Toronto)

Phil and Jonny previously worked together at Recursion. Ian and Phil have been collaborating for 5 years throughout their PhDs, doing ML research specifically for RNA biology. See preprints on early versions of the [model](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.10.617658v3) + [benchmark](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.07.05.662870v1). 

**What’s the problem?** 

mRNA is composed of four nucleotides (A, C, G, U). For the average mRNA therapeutic, there are \~10²⁷⁰⁹ possible combinations. This is unimaginably larger than the number of stars that exist in the known universe. 

A suboptimal sequence can kill your drug discovery program, costing pharma companies billions of dollars. But testing all of the possible sequences is impossible. How can you design the best sequence? 

**What are we building?** 

A family of RNA-specific foundation models that simulate costly and time-consuming experiments, predicting key properties like **expression** (how much protein is made from the mRNA) and **stability** (how long it stays in the body) before experiments ever begin. 

We’ve currently got the best **RNA foundation model**. It’s outperforming 59 models from leading research labs and companies. At 10M parameters, it’s lightweight and fast enough to run predictions on hundreds of sequences in seconds. The open-source model is already being used by **Sanofi and GSK**, and we’re also collaborating with the **Arc Institute** to bring our RNA embeddings into the next generation of virtual cells. 

**What’s next?** 

* We’re establishing a set of scaling laws that will bring a GPT-3 moment to RNA.  
* We’re curating one of the largest transcriptomic annotation datasets in the world to power model training
* As we improve the model, we’re expanding beyond mRNA design into a broader RNA toolkit, tackling problems like:
  * Target ID
  * Novel biomarker discovery 
  * Cell-type-specific mRNA design
  * …and more 👀

Here’s a peek into the vision that we’re building towards.

https://youtu.be/ZgI7WJ1SygI

**Our Ask**

* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/blank-bio) and[ X](https://x.com/blankbio_) 
* Share this post! 
* We’re looking to connect with pharma and biotech companies working on mRNA-based therapeutics (i.e. Moderna, BioNTech, Orbital, etc.), CRISPR therapeutics (Scribe, Intellia, Editas, etc.), and RNA biomarkers. An intro to anyone at these types of organizations would be huge. Please drop an email to [jonathan@blank.bio](mailto:jonathan@blank.bio)

name: Playgent
long_description:
When enterprise agents fail in production, the conditions that caused the failure are critical: user state, data, tool calls, and context. Without a way to recreate these conditions, teams can't fix what broke.

Playgent provides infrastructure to create high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Our environments come packaged as a single MCP url where tool calls are mocked, authentication is abstracted away, and test data can be initialized via natural language or JSON specifications.

Teams can use Playgent to reproduce production failures in safe, scoped environments that accurately reconstruct state. Finally, export runs as OTel traces from Playgent's environment to plug directly into your observability tools or RL pipelines.

Hey everyone 👋 I’m [Michael Schroeder](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michaelschroeder-/), and I’m the founder of [Overdrive Health](https://www.overdrive.health).

**TL;DR:**

[**Overdrive Health**](https://overdrive.health/) is automating the entire medical billing and RCM lifecycle in order to offer higher quality outsourced billing services, starting with the **$2bn ambulance billing industry** (U.S. ambulance industry is $40bn). If you know any fire chiefs/city managers, practice owners in any specialty, or have connections to EHR/ePCR companies, please reach out!

<https://youtu.be/DmZCsVoQORw>

**Problem:**

Healthcare providers spend somewhere between 2% and 10% of their revenue in order to get paid for services they have already provided. It can take a few weeks to several months (to never…) for them to get this money, and often requires hours and hours of manual work in order to get the claims actually paid.

The process is so complicated that the providers have 2 options: hire a small army of medical billers in-house in order to submit their claims to the insurance company, or pay a 3rd party up to 10% of their revenue to handle the claims for them, with little visibility into what is actually going on. Neither of these are great options; with the in-house route, providers spend countless hours interviewing, training and managing a team of people in an area that they don’t even have an expertise in, or they have to hope that some 3rd party will really chase every single dollar for them (guess what: they won’t).

**Solution:**

Overdrive Health is an AI-native, full-stack medical billing company that can actually afford to go after every single dollar that a provider is owed. By automating time-consuming tasks like insurance company phone calls, documentation quality checks, benefit verification and a slew of others, even a $100 claim becomes profitable for us to collect, which means our **incentives are truly aligned**. We can collect money **faster** than a traditional billing company, while maintaining **consistent, high-quality collections percentage** by utilizing a small team of expert billers behind our AI systems.

**Where we are now**:

We are acquiring a traditional ambulance billing agency that serves \~20 ambulance providers, doing over **$50mm in claims/yr**. Since launching our AI agents, their revenue per FTE has **nearly doubled**.

**Where we are going:**

The **$2bn EMS billing space** is just the beginning. We think that the technology and systems we’re building will be broadly applicable across all medical verticals, and we hope to provide the best possible RCM experience to all healthcare providers. If you know anyone in the EMS/ambulance space, or anyone who owns their own private practice in another medical vertical, please reach out to me at [**michael@overdrive.health**](mailto:michael@overdrive.health).

launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

Drug discovery is slow, and it costs billions of dollars. The bottleneck in early discovery is chemical synthesis. b-12 is building a full stack of AI agents to deliver planning and robotic executions of experiments, in minutes, not months. **Our team has developed custom robots for chemistry (Chemspeed), orchestrated AI agents for lab control (EPFL & IBM), and is translating this into a powerful and easy-to-use product.**

**Ask:** Are you running chemistry experiments or chemical robots? Do you know someone who is? Email us at [founders@b12-labs.com](mailto:founders@b12-labs.com) to be added to our pilot program. See below for details.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qmf7q-Sie2o

# ❌ **The problem:**

**Drug Discovery is slow:**

* It takes 10+ years and over $2 billion to discover a new drug.
* 2 in 10000 compounds make it.
* Chemistry execution is very slow.

Experiments take time! Designing good experiments and trial and error in the lab are big factors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/0cd3f202-e48b-48da-a6e5-3ae1572cddab)

**Software for chemists is fragmented:**

* There are many solutions for many different parts of the pipeline.
* Tools are outdated, and integration is largely missing.

**Lab robots are underused:**

* Most lab robots are _not accessible to scientists_ because they are hard to use.

* Lab automation engineers are hard to find.

We are integrating a full stack of Agents to **design experiments** and **write code for the robot** that runs these experiments, with the tools and context needed to predict chemically meaningful results, and close the experimental loop.\

* **Parallel and scalable to any lab:** We are vendor agnostic, and integrate with different robotics (Chemspeed, Unchained, Opentrons, etc.) and labs performing experiments manually.

**Pilot Program:** Our team will work on integrating Agentic solutions tailored to your lab's specific problems, whether you use lab automation or not. We want to speed up molecular discovery.

launches.title: Mohi: Debugging assistant for AI agents
launches.tagline: Don’t know why your agent messed up? Neither do we. But Mohi will show you exactly where your agents went wrong - and why.
launches.body:
Hey folks! 👋

We’re building Mohi, a debugging assistant for AI agents. If you've ever spent hours scrolling through 500+ LLM calls asking “what the hell happened?” — this is for you.

https://youtu.be/UzQZlUdZ59s

### The Problem

Agents are complicated — tools, memory, web search, nested loops, and hallucinations. And when something breaks, it’s like untangling spaghetti. You’re stuck scrolling through flat logs, guessing which of the _35_ steps silently failed.

It's slow, brittle, and makes you second-guess your whole stack.

### **The Fix**

Mohi makes debugging agents **_fast_**, and **_actually usable_**.

Just tag key steps in your agent with our lightweight SDK (think: tool calls, memory access, context switches, decision logics), and we build a clean visual graph of what happened under the hood. Then we go a step further and show you:

* where your agent last succeeded
* where it went off the rails (hallucinated, failed tool, wrong branch)
* and how to re-run broken steps with new inputs

It’s not just observability. It's a diagnosis.

### **Who We Are**

Previously, Hao worked on AI and distributed systems observability at AWS, and Evan worked on automated testing at Google and AI evaluations at SecureBio. We met at MIT and worked on a bunch of projects together, eventually building agents ourselves and seeing firsthand how painful debugging can be — so we built Mohi to fix it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92831&key=user_uploads/1675765/aa1f6344-8ce0-4ad5-a5ba-0e203412791a)

### **Our Ask**

If you’re building complex agents — we’d love to chat!

launches.title: Novaflow – The AI data analyst for biology labs
launches.tagline: Accelerating scientific progress
launches.body:
We’re Aman and Amulya, and we’re building Novaflow. 

**TL;DR —** Bioinformatics data analysis is a time-consuming and expensive process for scientists. With Novaflow, life scientists can upload experimental data, ask questions in plain English, and get instant, publication-ready plots, giving them results in minutes instead of months. 

[Intro Video](https://youtu.be/uwi8N9rjCUI)

### **Our Story**

Aman was a computational biologist and saw firsthand how his colleagues struggled to analyze their experimental results quickly due to a growing backlog of data in the lab. Despite spending over $100,000 a year on data analysis, it still wasn’t enough. He realized that using LLMs, this process can be automated away and save researchers time and money. He teamed up with his friend Amulya who was a software engineer at Zoom to bring this product to life. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92462&key=user_uploads/244146/e5819898-8cdb-480f-9c21-31590b2c7232)


### **The problem**

Life science labs generate huge datasets, but analysis is slow, expensive, and talent‑constrained:

* **Expensive.** Small labs routinely spend **$100k+/year per analyst**; large labs spend millions. 
* **Talent bottleneck.** Many groups run **\~5:1 experimentalists to analysts**, so researchers wait weeks to months for results.
* **Dual expertise required.** Useful analysis needs **both** strong coding skills and deep biological context—most researchers only have one.
* **Resource‑intensive + fragmented tooling.** Labs often lack scalable compute, standardization, or long‑term data management. Many are stuck with custom scripts and tools that feel **15+ years behind**.

### **Our Solution**

We want to put analysis **back in the hands of researchers**:

* 🧠 **LLM‑powered pipelines** that plan, generate, and run bioinformatics workflows behind the scenes
* 📊 **Instant, publication‑ready plots** from raw CSVs, FASTQs, BAMs., and more
* 🔍 **Natural‑language querying** (“Which genes are most differentially expressed?”)
* 🧪 **Exportable Jupyter notebooks & reproducible Python code** for auditability and downstream tweaking
* ♻️ **Versioned runs & provenance** so you can rerun, compare, and share analyses confidently

### **How it works**

1. **Upload your data + describe the experiment** (e.g., “scRNA‑seq of treated vs. control organoids”).
2. **Novaflow infers the right workflow** (e.g., QC, normalization, clustering/UMAP for scRNA‑seq; DE for bulk RNA‑seq; peak calling + motif analysis for ATAC‑seq).
3. **We spin up the compute, run the pipeline, and return plots**, summaries, and a notebook you can keep, rerun, or extend.

### **Who this is for**

* **Life scientists** blocked by slow or missing bioinformatics support
* **Academic labs** doing genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, etc.
* **Biotech teams** that want to accelerate R&D with leaner headcount
* **Clinical/diagnostic groups** using high‑throughput assays

### **Our Ask**

* [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/aman-novaflowapp/30min?month=2025-07) if you’re interested in seeing how Novaflow can support your lab! 
* Know a research lab, hospital, or biotech company that might benefit from Novaflow? Send us an email - we’d love an introduction! [contact@novaflowapp.com](mailto:contact@novaflowapp.com)

I (Angel) have had three knee surgeries since my mid-teens and was billed more than $250K for care that should have cost a fraction of that. Fighting those inflated charges was so painful that we set out to build a consumer-facing AI agent to do it for others. In less than five months, we helped sixty patients erase or reduce over $300K from their medical bills.

This inspired us to fix the problem farther upstream: stopping bad payments before the patient ever sees a bill. So we launched payment integrity, machine-learning models that audit every medical claim for self-insured employers and health plans in real time.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐦:
• Self-insured employers waste $60 B+ each year on claims that never should have been paid. Healthcare is the 2nd largest company expense after payroll.

• Manual audits are slow and partial: Reviewers focus only on high-dollar claims, letting millions more slip through unnoticed.

• Existing audit software is static: Decades-old rule engines can’t keep pace with evolving codes, contracts, or billing tactics.

• Incentives are misaligned: Third-party administrators are paid to process claims, not to police them, so accuracy checks are minimal.

𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:
Our models audit medical claims before and after payments have been issued. We catch nuanced billing, coding, and contract errors to save 3-7% on annual claims spend. We work with self-insured employers and health plans.

launches.tagline: We use AI to automate the entire referral loop including authorizations, patient communication and specialist follow-up.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Alejandro](https://www.linkedin.com/in/asalinas21/) and [Josh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshua-r-chang/) - cofounders of [Locata](https://www.locatahealth.com/) 👋

**TL;DR**

Referral management is one of the most time-consuming and error-prone tasks in healthcare. Locata eliminates that burden by automating the entire process with AI. This helps health centers streamline their operations, reduce costs, and ensure patients get timely care.

https://youtu.be/IwyUifa8MnE

## ❌ The Problem

Referrals are one of the most critical, yet most broken, parts of the US healthcare system. Health centers are required to track specialist referrals to ensure continuity of patient care and meet quality standards. **But with limited staff and overwhelming administrative demands, health centers struggle to keep up, leading many to outsource the work.**

**Consequences:**

* High error rates in referrals
* Denied authorizations and delays in specialist appointments
* Wasted time manually copying data between various systems

**Impact:**

These operational inefficiencies create major **financial risks** for health centers. On top of the resources centers already deploy to manage referrals, failure to effectively close the loop puts quality standards in jeopardy, carrying even greater financial implications.

## [👷](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker) Our Solution

Locata uses AI to automate the referral management process from end-to-end. Imagine having a team of the world’s best referral coordinators that operate with higher accuracy, lower costs, and faster delivery, giving health centers the capacity to scale on demand and close more referral loops.

* **AI auth submission**: Our AI extracts patient data directly from EHRs, intelligently maps it to the correct authorization forms across different payor portals, and submits requests automatically.
* **Automated status updates:** We monitor authorization status continuously, with automatic notifications sent to staff for cases requiring urgent attention.
* **Voice AI patient follow-up:** Our Voice AI calls patients on customizable cadences to monitor whether they’ve made a specialist appointment. Our system alerts staff when they need to step in to offer additional support.
* **Consult note retrieval**: Once a patient confirms an appointment, our AI automatically contacts specialists, requesting consult notes to effortlessly close the loop.

Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and are taking them live to automate their entire referral workflow.

## 🙏 Our Ask

* We would love introductions to physicians or administrative staff at health centers. Contact us at [**founders@locata.ai**](mailto:founders@locata.ai).
* Learn more at [**locatahealth.com**](http://locatahealth.com)

Alejandro and Josh have known each other for almost 10 years.

Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs, where he led AI projects that resulted in a patent submission. He holds a BS degree in Computer Science from Stanford University. As an undergrad, he conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine and shadowed doctors internationally.

My name is Eshan. I’ve spent the last 5 years trying to address what I think is the most pressing problem in the country — addiction and mental health. Before YC, I ran a group doing on the ground overdose prevention work across the country. I also worked at the White House on Drug Policy.

**Insurance companies love to scrutinize behavioral health treatment**, partially because it’s expensive (a single 30-day residential treatment episode can cost upwards of $50,000), and partially because proving medical necessity for behavioral health is a subjective process.

But behavioral health care _is_ medically necessary. **Drug overdose is the single biggest cause of death for young people in the US.** And there are too many stories of insurers denying people care, only for those individuals to later lose their lives to overdose.

We were in the summer ‘25 YC batch. Since then, we’ve been working with a small group of customers to develop a new product. I’m excited to announce it today.\
\
**Introducing: Perspectives Reclaim**

Because they’re under so much pressure from payors, behavioral health treatment programs currently spend an immense amount of resources and staff generating documentation and auditing it to be perfect. \
\
Reclaim solves this by

1. Reading tens of thousands of pages of charts every night
2. Finding issues that can lead to insurance denials or other issues
3. Tracking down which clinician made the error and emailing back and forth with them until it’s solved.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101622&key=user_uploads/2329278/a7ccf9c3-cf38-409a-a8d4-9c4421623a19)

\
In each of our pilots, we’ve flagged and resolved hundreds of issues, from missing documents to drug tests that weren’t happening when they were supposed to, **leading to more approvals from payors, higher revenue for our clinics, and better outcomes for patients.**

Reclaim’s agent can also help provide evidence when fighting against payor clawbacks and can generate the insurance documentation used to argue for more days of care.

In the last 4 weeks since launching Reclaim, we’ve gone from **0 —> $250k cARR.** Our vision is to replace the $30B spent on the financial and administrative services that keep these clinics afloat and give that capacity back to care.

**Asks**:

1. Intros to our ICP: we’re looking for multi-site behavioral health/SUD treatment centers that deal with commercial insurance.
2. We’re currently hiring a senior software engineer to help us scale. Any intros here would be appreciated.
3. Investor intros are always appreciated as well.

Here’s our launch video: <https://youtu.be/vvFe7AF3mUo>

launches.body:
**Perspectives Health is the AI assistant automating the admin work that slows down behavioral health clinics.**

[https://youtu.be/xL-XqY41L10](https://youtu.be/xL-XqY41L10%5C)

Hey everyone! We're Eshan and Kyle, founders of Perspectives Health.

We help the millions of clinicians and clinical directors finally use AI inside the outdated EMR systems they've been stuck in.

Most clinical record software works like Microsoft 95, has no modern APIs, and can't integrate with new tools. That leaves clinicians stuck doing endless manual computer work. 

Believe it or not, most behavioral health clinicians will spend 5 years of their lives just typing notes!

**The Problem**

* 60%+ of clinicians work outside of major hospital systems.
* Most of them use software that nobody can connect to.
* This means they can't access life-changing AI software, which could automate notes, billing, scheduling, and more.

**Our Solution**

* Connects to any web-based EMR instantly. Yes, we mean any EMR.
* Perspectives listens to sessions, writes notes better than a clinician, and populates them straight into any EMR. 
* No copy/paste. And we don't rely on browser agents, so our tool fills out any form in seconds, not minutes.

AI is rapidly improving, but most of healthcare is locked out due to legacy systems. Perspectives bridges that gap, making AI usable immediately. Clinicians want to help people. Not to be drowned in manual work. We're building toward a future where clinicians never touch a keyboard for documentation again—where intelligent systems handle every workflow outside of patient care. 

The first step is integrating seamlessly with outdated EMRs and filling in the critical workflows they lack. From there, we'll expand across specialties—behavioral health, speech therapy, physical therapy, veterinary care, and beyond—unlocking AI for every provider outside the hospital system.

**Our Traction**

* We're growing 25% every week.
* Once users try our product 5 times, the habit is built, and they never write notes without it.
* We have onboarded 9 clinics for our pilot program since YC started, and each is on track to onboard all our pilot clinicians by September (180 clinicians).

**Our Team**

Our founding team combines lived experience in mental health care, policy expertise from the White House Drug Policy team, and technical expertise in scalable AI systems.

**Our Ask**

If you're a behavioral health operator, clinician, or investor who believes AI should be helping providers now—not five years from now—let's talk.

Hey everyone! This is [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benjamin--rubin/) and [Yining](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yining-z/) from [Norra](https://www.linkedin.com/company/norra-io/), the AI equipment operations platform for nursing facilities.

TL;DR: Norra uses AI and real-time tracking to give nursing facilities operational intelligence they've never had.

🚨**The problem:**

Nursing facilities are facing an existential crisis. With the aging population, demand is surging but they can't keep up. Medicare cuts coupled with inefficient operations mean that over 50% of facilities lose money and are struggling to keep their doors open, all while facing a massive impending staff shortage.

Facilities run blindly with zero operational intelligence. They’re scrambling to manage equipment lifecycles, discovering things are broken too late (leading to failed audits), and over-purchasing because they don’t know what they have. This operational chaos costs each facility over $100K and 1,000 hours of staff time per year, time that could be spent caring for patients.

💡**The solution:**

<https://youtu.be/dI02IH5izfk>

With custom hardwares, Norra creates a digital twin of their entire facility, giving staff complete visibility into everything happening on the ground. With all of this data, we are able to use AI to transform the operational chaos into proactive decision making. Instead of reacting to equipment going into disrepair or overpurchasing equipment due to lack of visibility, staff now get actionable insights to prevent waste before it happens.

What it actually means: Preventative maintenance reminders and tracking, Intelligent and automated purchasing workflows, Insights to improve utilization and cut costs

**⚡Impact:** \
\
We've cut our first facilities' rental spend by 70% and projected to save them $100K+ this year.

Ben and Yining met two years ago at NASA building astronaut operation software. They are two roommates turned cofounders passionate about using AI to make a real impact in healthcare. 

Ben has spent 1000+ hours in hospitals and nursing facilities seeing first hand how broken their operations are.\

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Our mission is personal. Each of us watched someone we love slip through the cracks of today’s healthcare system. Peter’s grandfather suffered three preventable ER readmissions before passing—his ruptured aorta went undetected after missed medications and a complete absence of follow-up care. Lukas’s grandmother, who raised him, deteriorated in assisted living—isolated, depressed, and unrecognizable before passing unexpectedly just days before he arrived. Kazuki’s grandfather battled cancer alone in Japan, cut off from family by COVID-era hospital restrictions—reminding us that healing requires more than medicine.

What we experienced is not rare. It’s the reality for tens of millions of older adults. In ERs, nursing homes, and senior communities where we’ve volunteered, we saw the same  patterns: chronic conditions unmanaged, dangerous falls ignored, weeks without human connection, and emergencies that could have been prevented. Aging has become a quiet crisis—fueled by staff shortages, fragmented systems, lack of technology access, and stigma about growing old. 

We’ve invested 600+ hours on the ground working with older adults to deeply understand their’ needs, motivations, and barriers. Our team brings full-stack software, AI/ML, and hardware expertise from Neuralink, Stanford, and NVIDIA, along with operating experience leading major organizations like Zero2One (largest startup group at UIUC), Stanford Founders (1,500+ members), and Covalence (2,000 volunteers across seven universities)—this gives us the tools needed to lead transformation in this space. 

We’re here because we believe older adults deserve independence, dignity, and a healthcare system that truly cares—and we’re building Kaigo Health to make that the new standard.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our vision is to transform healthcare into a continuous, preventative, and home-based experience. We start by enabling high touch outpatient care for Medicare providers, supercharging value-based care. This builds consumer trust and a proprietary data layer, and leverages existing provider distribution networks to later phase in more advanced ambient sensing and care delivery technologies (e.g. home robot companions) for 24/7 personal health management - bringing healthcare to the home while hospitals focus on acute care.

https://youtu.be/c2BLsZJtZSg

**The Problem**

After every visit, patient care falls apart between systems.

Follow-ups, care plan adherence, and patient monitoring are manual, time consuming, and insufficient - leaving patients unsupported, nurses overloaded, and health systems losing billions to readmissions and other penalties.

**Our Solution**

Kaigo Health builds an **AI outpatient care workforce** - autonomous agents that continuously follow-up, monitor, and advocate for patients, then report back to their human care teams with actionable insights. All of this is delivered through simple, accessible phone calls with a voice agent specifically designed for older adults.

Kaigo **helps providers scale outpatient care management 100× without scaling headcount**, driving fewer readmissions, higher quality scores, and stronger value-based performance.

**Vision**

Kaigo aims to build a new infrastructure for healthcare beyond the 4 walls of the clinic - a layer of autonomous, scalable health monitoring, coordination, and delivery that seamlessly fills in the gaps between our current fragmented system, transforming healthcare into a continuous, ambient part of everyday life.

We’re starting with providers: giving them powerful technology to dramatically expand their outpatient care capacity, thrive under value-based care, and ensure every patient has a proactive, friendly voice looking out for their health between visits.

**Our Story**

We started Kaigo after seeing how fragile recovery becomes once patients leave the hospital. Our families wanted to stay healthy, yet support faded the moment they got home. We’re building Kaigo so care continues where life happens.

**TLDR:** Sunflower Sober started by building the best AI Sponsor on the market & powering over 21,500,000 days of sobriety. Now we are launching the **Sunflower Clinic of Addiction Medicine** to bring Therapy & Medication to our users, reimbursed by medicaid. We have over $153M worth of patients on a waitlist.

**App:** <https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sunflower-quit-any-addiction/id1547099435>

**Clinic:** <https://sunflowerclinic.com/>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112046&key=user_uploads/132378/fc76c836-d166-4caf-b46c-fc2f85ddb653)

Hello friends!!

Did you know that it is harder to build a **50 state SUD outpatient program that takes medicaid**, than it is to put rockets into space?

The licensing requirements once you start treating substances as a primary diagnosis are quite frankly insane, state-level medicaid approval, county level MCO contracts, physical facilities in every state.

But we started Sunflower to solve **hard problems**.

Most people look at us and think “hehe, a mobile app, a sobriety counter”. When we raised our pre-seed with no product and no revenue I told our early investors that this is my version of going to mars. Sunflower isn’t here to just build a sobriety counter. **We are trying to literally and objectively end addiction.**

We’re on a mission to create one TRILLION days of sobriety, one day at a time.

So far we have powered over 21,500,000 days.

We built the first AI Sponsor, named Sam, who has now had over **7,000,000 messages** with our users. More messages than any “entity” has ever had within a single lifetime about sobriety.

Sam is a critical piece to the sobriety journey. Almost 80% of surveyed users at d60 report Sunflower preventing at least one relapse, and **93.6% report a reduction in substance usage**.

But we’ve always known that an AI Sponsor is only a PART of what people need to get sober. They still need **therapy**. They still need **medication**.

The problem?

When you are struggling with substance abuse (alcohol or otherwise), you often don’t have $10 in your bank account to pay for gas.

We have too many users that downloaded Sunflower because **they can’t afford paying $125/hr for therapy**. That can’t afford dropping $350 a quarter for Naltrexone.

Outpatient programs for SUDs are one of the most regulated spaces within behavioral health, and because of this, access to care that _will actually take our users insurance_ (medicaid) is extremely limited.

This is why we are working to build the **Sunflower Clinic of Addiction Medicine**.

A 50 state telemedicine program for SUDs that _actually_ takes medicaid. Now live in MI & PA with SUD facility licensing, state medicaid approval, and in the final steps of county level MCO contracting.

We are combining our best in class AI Sponsor with Mayo Clinic MDs and therapy leadership that built group programs at Charlie Health from 8 - 300+ therapists … our goal is to build the **best outpatient program on the face of this planet** & get it covered by medicaid nationwide.

So far we have over **37,500+ patients on a waitlist** who have requested Therapy or Medication from Sunflower, representing a TAM of $153M waiting to be served.

We are going to solve one of the most important problems in human existence. A problem that globally we spend over $100B treating every year, and is the greatest shackle to the acceleration of humanity.

**Thanks for following along with our story.** Here’s some data. 🌻

launches.title: FinalDose: The first programmable drug to cure all cancers
launches.tagline: FinalDose is building the first programmable drug platform - a single smart drug molecule that finds diseased cells by their DNA and destroys them. We’re starting with all cancers.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

**For 60 years, drug discovery has chased proteins. But \~85% of disease drivers don't have a druggable protein, making them unreachable for modern medicine. The deeper issue: most disease doesn't start at the protein, it starts in the DNA that codes for it. We built a programmable drug that reads DNA inside the cell, decides if it's diseased, and destroys the cell if it is. One platform, reprogrammed to any disease distinguishable on a DNA level.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101229&key=user_uploads/2957085/2cb08187-4767-47e6-845e-1adc642aec61)

[Check us out](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=446etIvaYCM&t=2s)

**❌ The Problem**

Drug discovery hasn't really changed in sixty years. Pick a protein, throw millions of molecules at it, spaghetti at a wall, hoping something sticks. 10 years and $2.6B per drug.

The bigger issue is proteins aren't where most disease starts. Disease starts in the DNA. The protein is downstream - the symptom, not the cause. Which is why \~85% of validated disease drivers have no druggable protein at all. Cancers driven by MYC, TP53, APC; Viral reservoir; clonal populations that drive systematic risk. All "undruggable" with the old protein playbook.

**✨ Our Solution**

We went straight for the DNA.

We started with a DNA-sensing protein that undergoes a sharp structural change when it finds its target sequence. We hijacked that structure change and turned it into a kill switch:

1\. The molecule scans the genome for a hardcoded target sequence.

2\. When it finds the target sequence, our drug changes in structure

3\. The structural change triggers a kill switch

4\. The diseased cell containing the target DNA dies. Neighboring healthy cells are untouched.

Same molecular  molecule, new guide → new drug. This means R&D cycle and cost collapses to near 0.

The compounding asset: we already have decades of human genetics telling us which sequences cause which disease. We're not searching for new biology - we're turning genetics that's already in the textbooks into drugs.

**⚙️ Our Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101229&key=user_uploads/854295/ab013db6-2afe-4d60-a0b6-88a575695993)

(Left) **Jeff Liu - CEO**. Oxford PhD in Oncology. Previous startup (Vivid Dx) solved a multi-decade bottleneck in sepsis diagnostics: low biomass isolation. By overcoming this hurdle, we built the world’s fastest diagnostic system - slashing wait times from 5 days to just 30 minutes. Track record of closing institutional rounds - $5M seed and a $10M Pre-Series A.

(Middle) **Li-Yao Huang - CSO**. Oxford PhD in Biochemistry. Developed a comprehensive discovery-to-validation framework utilizing Cas9 and its derivatives to identify and verify novel therapeutic targets from high-throughput genetic-genetic and genetic-drug interaction data. Scientific lead in molecular biology, cellular assays, construct engineering.

(Right) **Steven Lin - CTO**. Oxford PhD in Computational Biology. Previously Data Lead at Gutsee Biotech. Developed novel machine learning method to use coevolution biology to identify genetic targets that convey drug resistance in viruses. During SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, led UK biobank analysis of human genetics susceptibility for infections

This will be the most general curative modality for any genetic mutation driven disease ever. Love to chat!

Find us at [founders@finaldose.ai](mailto:founders@finaldose.ai)
